STATIC_ROUTE_TEST.desc: Configure basic static route with default VRFs with PREFIX

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_INTERFACE.desc: Configure with nexthop as interface instead of IP address

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_ADVERTISE.desc: Configure static route with advertise flag

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_VRF.desc: Configure with routes in non default VRF

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_KEY_VRF_MGMT.desc: Configure with routes in mgmt VRF as key

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_VRF_MGMT.desc: Configure with routes with mgmt VRF as next hop

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_VRF_LEAK.desc: Configure with route leak across VRFS

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP.desc: Configure comma separated values for ECMP, with nexthop as PREFIX

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_WITH_INTERFACE.desc: Configure comma separated values with nexthop as INTERFACE

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_WITH_MGMT.desc: Configure comma separated values with one nexthop as mgmt

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BLACKHOLE_INVALID.desc: Configure with invalid value for blackhole

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_WITH_ADVERTISE_INVALID.desc: Configure static route with invalid advertise flag value

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_NEXTHOP_VRF_INVALID.desc: Configure with invalid value for VRF

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_DISTANCE_INVALID.desc: Configure with invalid distance for ECMP

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_BLACKHOLE_INVALID.desc: Configure with invalid blackhop for ECMP

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ECMP_NEXTHOP_VRF_INVAL.desc: Configure with invalid vrf for ECMP

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_NEXTHOP_EMPTY_VRF.desc: Configure with null value for VRF

STATIC_ROUTE_TEMPLATE_TEST_BFD_LIST_INVA.desc: Reject a per-nexthop list in bfd on the prefix-keyed list

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_ADVERTISE_LIST_INVALID.desc: Reject a per-nexthop list in advertise: it is a single route-level flag

STATIC_ROUTE_TEMPLATE_TEST_ADVERTISE_LIS.desc: Reject a per-nexthop list in advertise on the prefix-keyed list

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_MALFORMED.desc: Reject a misspelled interface name in ifname

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_MALFORMED_PORTC.desc: Reject a misspelled port channel in ifname

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_VLAN_OUT_OF_RAN.desc: Reject an out-of-range VLAN in ifname

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_ARITY_MISMATCH.desc: Reject an ifname list shorter than the nexthop list
eStr: ifname must have one comma-separated entry per nexthop

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_NEXTHOP_VRF_ARITY_MISM.desc: Reject a nexthop-vrf list shorter than the nexthop list
eStr: nexthop-vrf must have one comma-separated entry per nexthop

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BOTH_KEY_SHAPES_ONE_PR.desc: Reject one prefix configured both with vrf default and without
eStr: This prefix is configured twice: once with vrf default and once without

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_ALL_EMPTY.desc: Accept an ifname of only separators: every nexthop has no egress interface

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_TRAILING_EMPTY.desc: Accept an ifname whose last entry is empty

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_NULL.desc: Accept the null interface in ifname

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_IFNAME_REPEATED.desc: Accept the same interface for two nexthops

STATIC_ROUTE_TEST_BOTH_KEY_SHAPES_DIFFER.desc: Accept both key shapes when they name different prefixes

STATIC_ROUTE_IFNAME_SHORT_SUBINTERFACE_V.desc: Egress interfaces named in the short sub-interface form, Eth<n>.<vid> and Po<n>.<vid>, which is the only spelling available once the long name would exceed the 15-character limit

STATIC_ROUTE_BFD_WITHOUT_IFNAME_INVALID.desc: Enable BFD on a route with no egress interface, which staticroutebfd cannot program

STATIC_ROUTE_BFD_WITH_IFNAME_VALID.desc: Enable BFD on a route that names its egress interface, the shape this model intends to keep working
